parent_programme.relationship: Phase-IX assay-subset allocation successor; Phase-VIII fixed-field repeat results remain immutable

scientific_question: Are the exact-robust assay fields selected under Phase VII also efficient for the Phase-VIII stochastic 5 percent pairwise-risk objective, or can the same future target be resolved with fewer noisy assay readings by changing the field subset before replication?

fixed_objects.scored_units: the same 67 future-target-unresolved W1 fibers from Phases VII-VIII
fixed_objects.error_kernel: unchanged Phase-VIII symmetric categorical full-support iid kernel
fixed_objects.quality_calibration: excluded from the primary allocation search because Phase VIII showed zero repeat-depth or total-action savings under the frozen worst-pair criterion

three_designs.frozen_phase_viii: use exactly the Phase-VII canonical ecological assay fields and the Phase-VIII minimum equal repeat depth
three_designs.canonical_subset_reoptimized: search every non-empty subset of the frozen Phase-VII canonical assay fields; every selected field receives the same iid repeat depth n=1..30
three_designs.global_field_reoptimized: search every non-empty subset of all eight frozen W1 parameter fields; every selected field receives the same iid repeat depth n=1..30

objective.primary: minimize total noisy assay readings = number_of_selected_fields * repeat_depth subject to worst target-discordant pair BC/2 <= 0.05
objective.tie_break: minimum total readings, then fewer distinct fields, then smaller repeat depth, then lexicographically ordered field tuple

exact_search: enumerate every candidate field subset. For a fixed subset, compute the worst one-repeat Bhattacharyya affinity; because every selected field is repeated the same n times independently, the worst affinity at depth n is the nth power of the one-repeat worst affinity, so the smallest feasible n<=30 is exact for that subset.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one fiber reaches the frozen 5 percent pairwise bound with strictly fewer total noisy readings after reoptimizing over subsets of its Phase-VII canonical fields.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every canonical field is needed at the Phase-VIII reading cost in every fiber.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one fiber has a strictly lower total noisy-reading cost under the all-eight-field search than under the frozen Phase-VIII design.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if global field reoptimization never improves total reading cost.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one fiber is strictly cheaper under all-eight-field reoptimization than under canonical-subset reoptimization, implying that a field excluded from the exact-robust Phase-VII minimum becomes useful for the stochastic risk objective.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the all-field search never strictly improves on the best subset of Phase-VII fields.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one stochastic risk-optimal field subset differs from the Phase-VII exact-robust canonical ecological field set.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every risk-optimal design uses exactly the Phase-VII ecological field set.

secondary_outputs: frequency of each field in the lexicographically canonical risk-optimal design
S11 dormant-climate optimal subset and cost
fibers where deterministic exact-robust and stochastic risk-optimal field sets coincide
stop_rules: Do not change the 5 percent threshold, quality worlds, error kernels or repeat cap after scoring.
Do not introduce field-specific unequal replication in this phase.
Do not change the future target or W1 world universe.
Do not add a new assay field after observing the allocation results.
Do not interpret unit reading count as real field, laboratory, monetary, temporal or ethical cost.
Do not alter Phase-I through Phase-VIII results.

novelty_boundary.candidate_contribution: A BAM-specific demonstration that the evidence set minimizing exact finite-world target ambiguity need not be the evidence set minimizing repeated noisy-assay burden for the same occurrence-conditioned future ecological target.
